calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year 
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar 
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 8

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  tier,
  COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS member_count
FROM dim_member
WHERE valid_from <= '2025-12-21' AND valid_to >= '2025-12-21'
GROUP BY tier
ORDER BY tier

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS total_members,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN tier IS NULL THEN member_id END) AS null_tier_count
FROM dim_member
WHERE valid_from <= '2025-12-21' AND valid_to >= '2025-12-21'

SELECT member_id, COUNT(*) AS version_count
FROM dim_member
WHERE valid_from <= '2025-12-21' AND valid_to >= '2025-12-21'
GROUP BY member_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
LIMIT 10
